verdict.rationale: Linear exposes a full GraphQL API with API-key and OAuth2 authentication, a typed SDK, webhooks for event-driven automation, and documented rate limits/deprecation policy — all of which allow scripting issue creation, queries, and workflow automation entirely headlessly (e.g. from CI pipelines) without the UI. Missing for 10: no dedicated CLI tool or explicit CI/GitHub Actions integration guide, and no independent hands-on report of using the API in a CI pipeline.
